TYPE CHECK: The candidate value contains names of immortalized cell lines, which matches the field definition.
SOURCE CHECK: The paper describes mass spectrometry (MS) experiments to identify interaction partners of C18orf8 and NPC1. The "Identification of C18orf8 and NPC1 interaction partners by mass spectrometry (MS)" section explicitly states that "HeLa cells, or HeLa cells expressing 3xHA-C18orf8, C18orf8-3xHA, GFP-3xHA or NPC1-3xHA were lysed... and submitted to digestion... [and] acquired on an Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer". 293T cells are mentioned in the "Cell lines" and "Stable protein overexpression" sections as being used for lentiviral production and maintenance, but they are not listed as the source material for the MS analysis.
TRUTH CHECK: HeLa is correct as the source of the MS samples; 293T is incorrect as it was not used for the MS experiment.
COMPLETENESS CHECK: The set is incorrect because it includes a cell line not used for MS and only correctly identifies one that was.
